log: CAN WE EVEN GET THE SUBSTRATES? -- coverage gate before any docking is written
Three re-rankers have failed as per-protein priors because 68.5% of ranking errors are
enzyme-against-enzyme. The one untested version is PAIR-specific: dock the real substrate
into the candidate's pocket. That needs a 3D structure for the substrate, and the model
stores names. If most reactions have an unresolvable participant, the method cannot reach
them however well it works elsewhere, and that is decided here rather than after the build.

READING
22.6% of orphan reactions have NO non-currency metabolite at all -- protein-only steps,
transport of complexes, modifications. A small-molecule docking screen has nothing to dock
for these and they are outside the method by construction, not by failure.
Only 32.9% have even a resolvable main substrate. The last untested version of
structure-based re-ranking cannot reach most of the population, and the shortlist
should go to a curator unmodified.
